title: Gcd invariant
statement: For Boolean lists $z$ and $S$, the invariant holds when there are Boolean lists $x$ and $y$ such that $S$ is their pair encoding, each of $x$ and $y$ has length at most the length of $z$, and the greatest common divisor of the natural numbers represented by $x$ and $y$ equals that of the two components decoded from $z$.
caveat: The pair encoding, pair decoder, and binary-value function are not defined in the supplied context.
